messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — follow-up from last night's spike. Postmortem is up; we need owners/ETAs for noise reduction items: (1) reduce noisy ks.alert_high_mem on retries, (2) dedupe paging when same host triggers twice in 5m, (3) adjust paging window for background queue floods. Please pick an owner and ETA by EOD.

Raj: I'll take the dedupe work. ETA end of day Thu. Plan: add sliding window dedupe + tag by incident signature.

Jun: I'll handle the ks.alert_high_mem — preliminary thought: bump threshold to 85% for bursty jobs, add short cooldown. Want to test on staging first. ETA Mon.

Priya: I'll own paging window change. Propose increasing escalation window from 3 -> 6 mins for throttled queues. I'll draft runbook update and PR. ETA Fri.

Elaine: Thanks — add a short note in the action tracker and link PRs. Raj, add an alert example and affected services.

Raj: Added gist with rule diff:
```
alert: high_cpu_retry
expr: avg_over_time(cpu_usage[1m]) > 0.9 and increase_retries > 3
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Host {{ $labels.instance }} high CPU with retries"
```
We'll tag signature: {{service}}:{{metric}}:retry
Link -> https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/342

Jun: Staging test logs show cooldown at 30s reduces flapping 70%. Will run more and post metrics.

Priya: Draft runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks/pager-window.md PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/88 :thumbsup: 

oncall-bot: Reminder — assign owners in the postmortem doc or this thread will be auto-assigned to oncall-shadow after 48h.

Elaine: Noted. Raj/Jun/Priya confirm in thread when PRs merged and I'll close the action items.

Raj: PR merged. Verified no duplicate pages in 12h canary.

Jun: Staging validated. Will schedule production rollout Wednesday 03:00 UTC with canary.

Priya: Runbook PR merged and updated contacts. ETA met.

Elaine: Great — closing loop. Filing a follow-up to re-evaluate thresholds in two weeks (signal hygiene review). :tada:
